title_en: The First Landmark: Cursing and Detesting Ali (peace be upon him) - Part 2
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari continues the discussion on the landmarks of Umayyad Islam, focusing on the historical practice of cursing and detesting Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).
series_en: Muṭarahat fi al-Aqida - Ma'alim al-Islam al-Umawi
